$description: The paint roles of ui-materials as data: every shade, lit and glass colour a lit or transmissive table paints with, named by use. scripts/request.mjs turns this file into a ui-colors request fragment (key `translucent`), and ui-colors generates each role as a literal --colors-paint-<use> in every mode, so no table derives a colour in the browser. A role is a base colour at an alpha. The dark scheme's alpha is the light one times the base's scheme multiplier (capped at 1), unless the role is `fixed` or sets `darkAlpha` itself. Cast roles take their alphas from ui-geometry's elevation layers, never from this file. scripts/check.mjs keeps this file, the references and the generated system in step.

shade.is: the shadow colour: the near-black of the neutral in the light scheme, black in the dark one

face.is: the raised and overlay neutral face (the --element input: its default and fallback, and its dark-scheme role)

signal.is: the emissive colour (the --signal input's default; name another role here when a system remaps that input)

cast.source: ui-geometry: derive.mjs --elevation <level> --json, per scheme; the alphas are the same at every level

face-top.for: face shading, neutral faces: the top stop of the gradient
face-top.basis: white at 0.4 over a face at L 0.95 adds about +0.02 lightness, and nothing over a white face; tuned by eye

face-bottom.for: face shading, neutral faces: the bottom stop
face-bottom.basis: about -0.01 lightness on the default face; tuned by eye

face-top-solid.for: face shading, solid faces: the top stop
face-top-solid.basis: about +0.025 lightness on the default primary solid; tuned by eye

face-bottom-solid.for: face shading, solid faces: the bottom stop
face-bottom-solid.basis: about -0.01 lightness on the default primary solid; tuned by eye

bevel-top.for: bevel: the lit inset on top of a raised part

bevel-top-solid.for: bevel: the weaker lit inset on a solid face

bevel-bottom.for: bevel: the shade inset at the bottom

recess-ring.for: recess and pressed: the half-pixel shade ring

recess-lip.for: recess and pressed: the lit lower lip

pressed-1.for: pressed: the inner shadow, shallower than a recess

etch-top.for: etched: the faint shade inside the top edge
etch-top.basis: a starting value from an exploration (2026-11-13); not yet confirmed in a build

etch-ledge.for: etched: the lit line inside the bottom edge
etch-ledge.basis: a starting value from an exploration (2026-11-13); not yet confirmed in a build

etch-edge.for: etched: the shade hairline above the ledge, light scheme only
etch-edge.basis: a starting value from an exploration (2026-11-13); not yet confirmed in a build

display-1.for: display: the inner shadow, deeper than a recess

display-sheen.for: display cover when lit: the pane's reflection

hole-lip.for: hole: the lit line on the lower inner wall

lamp-glow.for: emissive: the glow around a lamp that is on

cast-1.for: cast: layer k = 0, the contact layer

cast-4.for: cast: layer k = 3, the far halo

glass-frosted-top.for: frosted glass body: the top stop of the face

glass-frosted-bottom.for: frosted glass body: the bottom stop

glass-clear-top.for: clear glass body: the top stop

glass-clear-bottom.for: clear glass body: the bottom stop

glass-frosted-top-line.for: frosted glass body under delineation line: the top stop

glass-frosted-bottom-line.for: frosted glass body under delineation line: the bottom stop

glass-clear-top-line.for: clear glass body under delineation line: the top stop

glass-clear-bottom-line.for: clear glass body under delineation line: the bottom stop

rim-frosted-top.for: frosted rim: the lit top line

rim-frosted-ring.for: frosted rim: the lit half-pixel ring

rim-frosted-bottom.for: frosted rim: the shade bottom line

rim-frosted-outer.for: frosted rim: the outer shade ring

rim-clear-top.for: clear rim: the lit top line

rim-clear-outer.for: clear rim: the outer shade ring

cover-reflection-1.for: display cover under glass: the bright band

cover-reflection-2.for: display cover under glass: the faint band
